metadata.title: Contract drafting from your Word template
metadata.description: Upload a Word contract template, answer a few questions, edit the draft and download it as .docx.

errors.invalid_response: The server sent a response this page cannot read. Reload the page and try again.
errors.draft_closed: This draft is no longer open.
errors.unauthorized: This browser has no saved drafts session (it may have expired, or cookies were cleared). Upload the template again to start a new one.
errors.stale: The draft or its answers changed since you loaded them. Reload to get the latest version.
errors.busy: This request is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.budget: This browser session has used its AI allowance, so the assistant cannot reply. Before a draft exists you can still fill in details under Details; afterwards, edit the draft in the document.
errors.storage_unavailable: Storage is temporarily unavailable. Your latest unsaved changes are still in this browser tab; retry shortly.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Retry in a moment.
errors.not_zip: This file is not a Word .docx document.
errors.zip_bomb: The document expands to more than the supported size.

workspace.beforeWord: Before you open it in Word
workspace.copied: Your version was saved as a new draft.
workspace.leaveTitle: Your latest edits could not be saved
workspace.leaveBody: Leave this draft anyway? The edits made since the last save will be lost.
workspace.clausesName: {count, plural, one {Clauses, # needs attention} other {Clauses, # need attention}}
workspace.regenerateBody: The draft is rebuilt from the template with your current answers. Edits you made in the editor are replaced.
workspace.assistantOffDraft: The assistant is off for this template because the AI analysis did not run. Edit the draft directly in the document.
workspace.assistantOffDetails: The assistant is off for this template because the AI analysis did not run. Fill in the details under Details.
workspace.waitForDraft: Wait for the draft to finish.
workspace.newTemplateBody: This draft stays saved. You can reopen it any time from Saved drafts.

header.availableWhenReady: Available when the draft is ready

status.detailsNeeded: {details, plural, one {# detail} other {# details}} still needed
status.decisionsNeeded: {decisions, plural, one {# decision} other {# decisions}} still needed
status.bothNeeded: {details, plural, one {# detail} other {# details}} and {decisions, plural, one {# decision} other {# decisions}} still needed

notices.conflictTitle: This draft was changed somewhere else.
notices.conflictDetail: This draft was changed elsewhere (another tab or an answer update). Reload the draft to continue.
notices.saveAsNew: Save mine as a new draft
notices.notSavedTitle: Your latest edits are not saved.
notices.wordBody: Word downloads a copy of the saved draft; use Save As to keep it. If nothing opens, Word may not be installed on this device, so use Download Word file instead.
notices.wordFailed: The draft could not be opened in Word.
notices.filledSoFar: {count, plural, one {# paragraph filled so far} other {# paragraphs filled so far}}
notices.interruptedTitle: The last draft generation was interrupted
notices.staleTitle: Some answers changed since the draft was made
notices.staleDetail: Regenerating rebuilds it from the template and replaces your edits.

export.notSaved: Your latest edit is not saved yet, so {action, select, word {Word} other {the download}} would miss it. Retry saving first.
export.wordIntroBody: Your browser then asks once whether this site may open Word. Tick the box that always allows it, and the next drafts open in Word straight away.

check.outstanding: {count, plural, one {# required detail has} other {# required details have}} no answer yet: {labels}. Check that the text is right in the document.
check.failed: The check for missing details could not run. Look over the document before sending it.

generation.ready: The draft is ready to edit.

editor.openFailed: The document could not be opened
editor.filling: {count, plural, one {Filling the template… # paragraph so far} other {Filling the template… # paragraphs so far}}

upload.heading: Draft a contract from your Word template
upload.intro: Upload a .docx template. The assistant asks for the missing details and writes them into your document, so its formatting carries over.
upload.readingDetail: Checking the file and finding the fields to fill. This usually takes a few seconds.
upload.limits: One .docx file up to {maxMb} MB, in English, French or both.
upload.blanks: Blanks can be [NAME], '{{date}}', a line of underscores or Word placeholder boxes.
upload.problemTitle: This file could not be used
upload.notDocx: “{name}” is not a Word .docx file. If your template is a .doc, PDF or Pages file, open it in Word, save it as .docx, then upload that copy.
upload.tooLarge: “{name}” is {size, number, ::.0} MB. Files up to {maxMb} MB are supported; remove large images from the template and try again.
upload.exampleFailed: The example could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
upload.linkedToBrowser: Drafts are linked to this browser.
upload.privacyFile: One unencrypted .docx up to {maxMb} MB. Macros are never run.
upload.privacyAi: To find the fields and understand your answers, the template text and your messages are sent from the server to Google's Gemini model, directly or, when configured, through Vercel's AI Gateway.
upload.privacyFormatting: Values are written into the template's own text, so fonts, numbering, tables, headers and footers carry over. Review the draft before you rely on it.
upload.privacyStorage: No account is needed. Drafts are saved on the server, linked to this browser, and kept for a set period after their last save.

chat.title: Drafting assistant
chat.languageHint: Auto answers in the language you write in
chat.placeholder: Answer a question or ask about a clause…
chat.hint: <kbd>Enter</kbd> sends, <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> adds a line. Write in English or French.
chat.thinking: The assistant is working on a reply
chat.updated: {count, plural, one {# detail updated} other {# details updated}}
chat.sendNotSaved: Your latest edit could not be saved, so the message was not sent. It is back in the box below; send it again once saving works.
chat.conflictNotice: You edited the text where {count, plural, one {this answer} other {these answers}} appeared ({answers}), so your edit was kept and the draft was not changed there. Update it in the editor, or regenerate the draft from the template (this discards manual edits).
chat.clauseNeedsConfirmation: “{label}” should now be {action, select, exclude {removed} other {included}}, but you edited it. Confirm it under Clauses.

fields.noFieldsTitle: No fields were found in this template
fields.noFieldsBody: Mark the blanks in Word as [NAME], '{{name}}', a line of underscores or a placeholder box (content control), then upload the template again.
fields.lockedAssistant: A draft exists, so change answers in the chat. The draft is then updated wherever you have not edited it yourself.
fields.lockedNoAssistant: A draft exists and the assistant is off for this template, so edit the text directly in the document.
fields.openAssistant: Answer in the chat, or fill a detail in here.
fields.openNoAssistant: The assistant is off for this template, so fill each detail in here.
fields.inactive: Only used by a clause that is excluded or still undecided.
fields.lowConfidence: Found with lower confidence. Check that it really is a field.

issues.ambiguous_date: “{input}” could be {a} or {b}. Which one did you mean?
issues.invalid_date: “{input}” is not a real calendar date.
issues.unreadable_date: “{input}” could not be read as a date. Write it like 1 October 2026.
issues.ambiguous_amount: “{input}” could mean {thousands} or {decimal}. Which one is it?
issues.unreadable_amount: “{input}” could not be read as an amount.
issues.ambiguous_currency: “{symbol}” is used by several currencies ({candidates}). Which one is it?
issues.unknown_currency: “{input}” is not a recognised currency. Give its name or ISO code, for example EUR.
issues.invalid_boolean: Answer yes or no: “{input}” does not settle it.
issues.invalid_email: “{input}” is not a valid email address.
issues.unit_mismatch: The template counts this in {unit}. How many {unit}?
issues.date_order: The end date ({end}) is not after the start date ({start}).
issues.conflicting_values: Two different values were given ({values}). Which one is right?
issues.ambiguous_reference: “{evidence}” could refer to {candidates}. Which one did you mean?
issues.required_field: The template needs this detail, so it cannot be left blank. Mark it optional if it really is.
issues.translation_needed: This text also appears in the {missing, select, fr {French} other {English}} part of the contract. Add the {missing, select, fr {French} other {English}} wording.
issues.detected_blank: Found from a blank line in the template. Check what it should contain.
issues.detected_cell: Found from an empty table cell. Check what it should contain.

resolution.unknown: Not known yet, asked again later

clauses.title: Conditional clauses
clauses.summary: {included} included, {excluded} excluded{waiting, plural, =0 {} other {, # waiting for you}}.
clauses.none: This template has no conditional clauses.
clauses.explainer: Clauses follow your answers; a suggested condition applies only after you confirm it.
clauses.problems: {count, plural, one {# problem to review} other {# problems to review}}
clauses.pendingBody: The answers call for {state, select, excluded {removing} other {changing}} this clause, but you edited it in the draft. Removing it keeps your edited version, which comes back if the clause is included again.
clauses.editedKept: Your edited version is kept and will be restored if this clause is included again.
clauses.answerInChat: Answer in the chat, so the draft is updated safely.

compare.label: Comparison with the template
compare.changes: {count, plural, one {# change from the template} other {# changes from the template}}
compare.filled: {count, plural, one {# placeholder filled} other {# placeholders filled}}
compare.clausesExcluded: {count, plural, one {# clause excluded} other {# clauses excluded}}
compare.comparedWith: Template compared with {source, select, editor {the draft as it is in the editor now (including changes not saved yet)} working {the saved draft} other {a preview of the draft your current answers would produce (no draft has been generated yet)}}.
compare.matchesBody: Nothing has been filled in, added or removed yet.
compare.footnote: This compares content and structure: text word by word, bold, italic and underline, paragraph styles, heading and list levels, and table cells. It does not compare fonts, sizes, colours, spacing or page layout, and it adds nothing to the document you edit or download.

drafts.title: Saved drafts
drafts.explainer: Drafts are saved on the server for this browser only, with no account. Other browsers, devices and private windows cannot see them. Each draft is kept until the date shown; saving moves that date forward.
drafts.emptyTitle: No saved drafts in this browser yet
drafts.emptyBody: Upload a template to start one. It is saved as you work.
drafts.deleteBody: The draft, its answers and its conversation are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
